# Product

## Register

product

## Users

Geoff and the coding agents building his applications. They need to discover a
capability, understand its fit and cost, see real behavior, integrate it correctly,
and carry an improvement to another application without losing either app's identity.

## Product Purpose

The Gallery is app-kit's working catalog and experience laboratory, not a marketing
landing page. Its primary task is choosing and proving the smallest useful capability
for a concrete application workflow. The Assistant exposes the same catalog to agents.
Success is a completed, trustworthy experience in a consumer, not a component count.

## Brand Personality

Precise, expressive, calm. These qualities come from the owner-approved
[vision](VISION.md): readable information, deliberate composition, purposeful motion
and crisp response. Dense comparisons and spacious decisions can coexist. Consumer
brands remain independent of the Gallery's own restrained presentation.

## Anti-references

A wall of attractive numbers without meaning or action; every app becoming the same
dashboard of cards; placeholder controls presented as working features; decorative
motion; a polished screenshot concealing broken keyboard paths or misleading data.
Commercial UI packs inform composition, not domain truth or redistribution rights.

## Design Principles

1. Begin with the user's decision and next action.
2. Demonstrate real behavior and difficult states, not merely component appearance.
3. Show dependencies, compatibility, maturity and evidence before adoption.
4. Preserve app identity while sharing semantic and interaction foundations.
5. Let improvements travel with a reproducible test and upgrade path.

## Accessibility & Inclusion

Keyboard and pointer paths are peers. Use semantic landmarks and controls, visible
focus, readable labels, zoom and designed narrow-screen navigation. Honor reduced
motion. Information must survive loss of color, hover, motion or a fast connection.
Analytical views include a text or table alternative. Automated checks supplement
running-product review; they do not establish blanket accessibility conformance.

## Authority

This captures approved context from [principles](docs/intent/principles.md),
[experience contracts](docs/design/experience-system.md) and the vision. It does not
introduce a second scope or promise that planned capabilities have shipped.
